presentation.name: Turn a requested metric into a definition that can be implemented twice
presentation.summary: Turns a metric requested in words into a specification precise enough that two independent implementations produce the same number.
benefits: Surfaces the decisions a one-sentence request hides: population and exclusions, grain, which date, units, thresholds
Settles how the metric rolls up, so a date filter cannot turn a rate into an average of rates
Decides up front whether late data restates a published figure
Asks for business rules instead of supplying a plausible one that becomes the definition of record
Carries worked edge cases, so an implementation can be tested rather than reviewed
Requires the report and an independent query to agree, and treats a disagreement as a missing clause
